verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator's core sync/backup functionality is tied to signing into a Google Account and Google's cloud (google-authenticator-docs-1, docs-4), with no documented option to run the syncing/backend infrastructure on infrastructure the user controls. The GitHub repo only ships client-side OTP generator code and a PAM module, not a self-hostable version of the actual product experience users rely on (cloud sync across devices), and community evidence explicitly complains that codes are locked into Google's account/cloud with no viable self-hosted alternative (google-authenticator-comm-6, comm-7, comm-12). missing for 10: any documented self-hosting mode, exportable open backend, or first-party guidance for running the service outside Google's infrastructure.
